episodes.title: FULL INTERVIEW: Andy Ngo exposes the Zizian Cult
episodes.description:
Bestselling author and investigative journalist Andy Ngo joins Victoria Taft to break down his book, The Zizians: Inside the Trans Death Cult. Ngo reveals the dark ten-year trail of violence, murder, and chemical body disposal left by an underground group led by Jack Lasota ("Ziz"). Drawing recruits from top tech firms (Google, NASA) and elite universities (Oxford, UC Berkeley), the cult combined radical trans ideology, autism/Asperger's traits, sleep deprivation experiments, and militant veganism. Ngo explains how cult members justified killing "carnists" (meat-eaters) to appease future super-intelligent AI, how institutional media suppressed the story to avoid accusations of transphobia, and details the nationwide manhunt that ended in a Maryland snowstorm.   

00:00 Introduction: Andy Ngo on the Darkest Investigation of His Career

15:30 "Jailbreaking" the Mind: Gruesome Sleep Deprivation and Hormone Experiments 
19:00 Militant Veganism: Why the Cult Believed AI Required Human Sacrifices 
23:00 The Arrest: Winter Box Truck Manhunt in Western Maryland 
27:15 Trans Identity Extremes: From Two-Spirit to Dragon Identities

episodes.title: The Cult Playbook? Ex-Antifa on Recruitment, Roles & Exit
episodes.description: An unfiltered look at Portland’s rolling showdown around the ICE facility. In this episode, you’ll hear how former Antifa participants describe the movement’s internal roles, how safe-house logistics work on the ground, and why noise operations target neighborhoods as much as officers. You’ll follow the citizen-journalist chase that helped identify a suspected rock attacker, plus a breakdown of where organizers really work when the costumes come off. Then you’ll hear a veteran PI connect dots between organizers, public-sector unions, and NGOs—and what he says prosecutors should publish if they’re serious about accountability. #Portland #Antifa #ICE #Protest #CitizenJournalism #SafeHouse #BlackBloc #NGO #SEIU #LawAndOrder #FreeSpeech #PortlandOregon
